steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Outta the way! Outta the way!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Stop right there! Give it up and let me take you down!

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Hey, Vigna, calm down! Don't go out ahead!

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: What is she so worked up for today?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: What, you haven't heard? There's some rock band putting on a concert at the city we're stopped next to. Vigna's been looking forward to it for days.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Well, alright. No wonder.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Right? Anyway, let's go after her. Wouldn't want her to run into any trouble.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Hey, Vigna? I know you're excited about that concert, but try to calm down a bit.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Oh, right. My bad.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: It's fine. I'm not yelling at you or anything, just a friendly reminder.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: That's right. You did a great job. You were a little worked up, but your judgment is just as great as always. You did everything you were meant to do. You've grown up, Vigna.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Hehe, I've been training every single day, y'know!

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Haha, that's terrific. I wasn't nearly as industrious when I was your age.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Seeing as you're so excited today, I'm guessing the concert's something to look forward to?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Yeah, I love this band!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: And, I mean, it's not always there's a concert right when we're stopped next to a city!

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: True that.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Besides, going to rock concerts in person is like a whole different experience from listening to a CD! You guys should come, too!

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Haha, I'll pass. Rock 'n' roll is a bit too loud for my ears.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: More or less the same for me, but we'll do what it takes to make sure you get to that concert tonight.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: That's right!

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Tsk, these bastards know how to ambush, huh?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: With a pack this big, my guess is these beasts have a leader or something.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: I think so too, but it's probably not in this group we're chasing. We would've found it already if it was.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: What should we do? Take a look around this area?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Last one!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Okay, that should be it, right?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Haha. Yeah, let's call it a day here.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: We have all these teams out here bringing their numbers down. Even if we don't get the pack leader today, it'll be some time before they can kick up a fuss again.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Haha, you're right about that. Maybe they never had a leader in the first place.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Hey, Vigna, you gonna make it to that concert of yours in time?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: It's 2:10 right now. Hm, we'll need to head back to the ship for debriefing, and that's going to take about an hour, then it'll take another hour to get to town. The concert starts at five.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Yeah, I'll make it!

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Perfect. Let's head back and report.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: We're home!

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Good work.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Where's everyone else?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: All the other teams have already finished their assignments. You guys are the last team back.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Alright, so that's a wrap, right?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Well, it is, but...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Well, here's the deal.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: When Team C was chasing away the beasts, they were attacked by what they thought was the pack leader. There were a lot of them, too, so the team decided to retreat.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: See? I told you.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: What are you so cocky about? I knew this was going to happen too!

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Our contract with the city government stipulates that we have to eliminate the threat of the beasts that's keeping their residents locked down.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: So you mean we have to go back and take care of this threat once and for all?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: That's right. Of course, because of the change in plans, we're reorganizing the mission roster. You don't have to participate if you don't want to.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Well, how can we possibly back out after you told us all that?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: That's right. We'll see it through, but well...

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Vigna, you still have your concert, right? Just go. Leave this to the rest of us.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Huh? Concert?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Yeah... It's starting in a few hours.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: I see. You should get going, then. Don't worry about us.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: I can't do that...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: I'm going on this mission too.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Don't worry about us. This is nothing too tough. The beasts have a leader, that's all. We can handle it ourselves.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: That's right. Didn't you say you love this band? Just leave it to us and enjoy the concert.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: But...!

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Vigna, I'm glad you're worried about us, but you really don't have to. You completed your mission already, so just take it easy and enjoy the concert.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Main Vocalist
steps.text: Are y'all ready to rock?!

steps.name: Audience
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Main Vocalist
steps.text: Let's rock this place up all night!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Ohh!!!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Man, a concert is totally different in person!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: I really should've dragged them here with me.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: But they...

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Haha, I'll pass. Rock 'n' roll is a bit too loud for my ears.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: More or less the same for me, but we'll do what it takes to make sure you get to that concert tonight.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Hey, Vigna, you gonna make it to that concert of yours in time?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: *Sigh*... Screw it...

steps.name: Audience Member A
steps.text: Hey, what was that for?!

steps.name: Audience Member B
steps.text: Watch it, cupcake! What are you even doing, going that way?!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Excuse me! Sorry, coming through!

steps.name: Audience Member C
steps.text: My popcorn!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Whoa, sorry!

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Huh? Vigna, why are you back so early?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Didn't you say the concert was going to last all night?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Where are they?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Who's 'they?'

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: The guys I was on the mission with this afternoon!

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Gotta hand it to them. These beasts are crafty.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Yeah, looks like they're hiding now that they know we're a threat.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Well, no wonder they managed to keep this ruckus up for so long.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: So what should we do? Think we should talk to the other teams and head back to ask for a few extra pairs of hands?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Let's just keep looking.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: We'd be making fools of ourselves going back for help after we said all that in front of Vigna.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Eh, speaking of which, I really mean it. She's such a sweet young lady.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: I've never seen a Sarkaz so full of energy.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Woah, you got a problem with Sarkaz?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Hey, don't get the wrong idea. I've been with Rhodes Island for so long, I've got nothing against the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: I might have something against you, though.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: You could really use a beating sometimes, you know that?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Alright, alright. Whatever. My bad.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Yeah, I'm pretty fond of Vigna too. Not only did she want to bring us to that concert, she was gonna miss it just to come with us on this job...

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: She's not only full of energy. She's got a sense of responsibility. Not a lot of kids these days are like that.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: That's why old folks like us are fighting, so that kids like her can do what they want to do. So let's cut the chatter and get back to work.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Heh, feels like you've been stealing the words right out of my mouth the whole night.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Hm? There's movement, nine o'clock.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Sounds like they're running. Two of them... like one chasing the other...

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Another squad, maybe?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Let's go take a look.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Tsk, I thought it came this way. Where did it go?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: I don't see anyone else. What a pain.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Hey, Vigna, what are you doing here?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Huh? There you are!

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: We heard movement over here and figured we'd come check.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: I thought you went to that concert of yours?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: I just couldn't leave you, so I came back.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: You're kidding. That's a whole lotta money down the drain!

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Hey, what'd you kick my butt for?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Watch your mouth. That's no way to talk.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Vigna, you sure about this?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Don't worry, I talked to Logistics already. I figured missions are more important than concerts.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Alright, stick with us, then. We make a good team.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: By the way, what's that you're carrying on your back?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Oh, this is my guitar. I brought it with me since I was going to get it signed. I didn't have time to put it away before coming out here.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Alright, enough. See if you can follow their tracks.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Why do I have to do it?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: With how ungrateful you were? You better be happy that's all I'm asking from you.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Alright, alright, fine.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Vigna, let's go. Let's try to take this whole pack down tonight.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: This way. I found their nest!

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Signal the other squads. We'll attack together.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: I'll do it!

steps.name: Pack Leader
steps.text: *Howls*!!!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Take this!

steps.name: Pack Leader
steps.text: *Whimpers*...

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Beautiful work, Vigna.

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Hehe.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Now that should actually be a wrap. Let's take a break. After that, we'll search the area before heading back.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Alright. Vigna, you too. Get some rest.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Why are you taking your guitar out?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Hehe, I said I wanted to take you to the concert, no?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: The concert isn't happening, but I can play their songs for you.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator A
steps.text: Huh? Well, sounds like a plan.

steps.name: Vanguard Operator B
steps.text: Haha, let's get the other guys here, then. Our in-house rocker, Vigna, is putting on her debut concert tonight!

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Hehe. Y'all ready?

steps.name: Vigna
steps.text: Let's rock this place up all night!
